data.title: 奥萝拉 · 记忆苍雪中的单杠远眺
data.description: 旧时代记忆幻境的雪原操场旁，老旧木制单杠被积雪覆盖。身穿朴素水手服的少女奥萝拉双手撑在单杠上晃荡双腿，仰望漫天大雪。
data.location: snowy schoolyard clearing framed by weathered rustic wooden fences and pine trees
data.action: perched seated on wooden gymnastic bar, legs swinging freely above snow, head tilted toward falling snowflakes with serene nostalgic gaze
data.lighting: 风雪漫射柔白光与雪原反光
data.promptProse: Young Aurora in a vintage sailor uniform perches atop a wooden exercise bar in the snow, watching snowflakes drift down with quiet nostalgia.
data.animaCaption: Snowflakes collect softly in her dark hair as she idly swings her legs.
